steps.en: The offender gets an SMS reminder that refers to the 2nd letter
steps.id: Offender menerima SMS reminder yang merujuk ke surat ke-2
steps.why_en: Reminder job and SMS sending are switched off in production, so reminders only go out by manual action.
steps.why_id: Job reminder dan pengiriman SMS dimatikan di produksi, jadi reminder hanya keluar lewat tindakan manual.

steps.en: Offenders who opted out of electronic reminders are left out
steps.id: Offender yang opt out dari reminder elektronik dikecualikan
steps.why_en: The opt-out check is correct but sits in the reminder job that is switched off in production.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan opt-out sudah benar tetapi ada di job reminder yang dimatikan di produksi.

steps.en: Notices due for the 3rd letter are picked for a particulars check at MHA
steps.id: Notice yang waktunya surat ke-3 dipilih untuk dicek particulars-nya ke MHA

steps.en: Foreign-ID and company offenders are checked through a second data source
steps.id: Offender berID asing dan perusahaan dicek lewat sumber data kedua
steps.why_en: This second check is switched off in production, so these offenders are not refreshed.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan kedua ini dimatikan di produksi, jadi offender tersebut tidak diperbarui.

steps.en: The latest address from MHA is saved and used for the letter
steps.id: Alamat terbaru dari MHA disimpan dan dipakai untuk surat

steps.en: Checked notices become ready for the 3rd letter
steps.id: Notice yang sudah dicek siap untuk surat ke-3
steps.why_en: Nothing makes the letter wait for the particulars check; the two run on separate schedules.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang membuat surat menunggu pengecekan particulars; keduanya jalan di jadwal terpisah.
